title_ar: فضيلة الشيخ يفتتح ملتقى الفقه الإسلامي بمركز تكوين العلماء
title_en: The Sheikh Opens the Forum on Islamic Fiqh at the Centre for the Formation of Scholars
body_ar:
افتتح سماحة الشيخ العلامة محمد الحسن الددو رئيس مركز تكوين العلماء بموريتانيا صباح اليوم الأربعاء 20 رجب 1437 هـ الموافق 27 ابريل 2016م، أعمال الملتقى الفقهي الأول الذي ينظمه مركز تكوين العلماء برعاية البنك الشعبي الموريتاني بحضور كوكبة من علماء موريتانيا وعدد من الأساتذة والباحثين في مجال الصيرفة الإسلامية، وقد استهل فضيلة الشيخ كلمته بالتذكير بأن نصوص الوحي محصورة والنوازل غير محصورة، ومهمة الفقيه هي تغطية النوازل غير المحصورة من خلال النصوص المحصورة، مشيرا إلى أن الاقتصاد أصبح اليوم هو عصب حياة الناس لذا كان لزاما أن تنقاش قضاياه على بساط الفقه، وأن يشارك الفقهاء المرموقون المخلصون الذين درسوا الفقه ولم ينغلقوا عن الواقع في بحث ونقاش الإشكالات المطروحة في مجال المعاملات المصرفية لإيجاد الحلول الإسلامية، قبل أن يختم الشيخ كلمته بشكر القائمين على تنظيم هذا الملتقى والمشاركين فيه من قامات علمية سامقة ومؤسسات، كما شكر الشيخ أيضا الداعمين لهذا الملتقى والإخوة الباحثين الذين تعبوا في إعداد البحوث التي ستقدم في هذا الملتقى.
ويناقش الملتقى خلال ثلاثة أيام عدة مواضيع من بينها، خطاب الضمان وحكم الأجرة عليه، والمواءمة بين الحق العام في الضريبة وحماية الحق الخاص، والتأمين وأحكامه، وكذا حكم فتح الحساب في البنوك الربوية.
body_en:
His Eminence the erudite Sheikh Muhammad al-Hasan al-Dedew, president of the Centre for the Formation of Scholars in Mauritania, opened this Wednesday morning, 20 Rajab 1437 AH, corresponding to 27 April 2016, the proceedings of the First Juristic Forum, organised by the Centre for the Formation of Scholars under the patronage of the Banque Populaire de Mauritanie, and attended by a distinguished company of Mauritania's scholars and a number of academics and researchers in the field of Islamic banking. The Sheikh opened his address by recalling that the texts of revelation are finite while novel cases are not finite, and that the jurist's task is to cover the unbounded novel cases by way of the bounded texts. He observed that the economy has today become the lifeblood of people's affairs, and that it was therefore imperative that its questions be debated on the ground of fiqh, and that eminent and sincere jurists — those who have studied fiqh and have not shut themselves off from present reality — should take part in examining and debating the difficulties raised in the field of banking transactions, so that Islamic solutions may be found. The Sheikh closed his address by thanking those who organised this forum and those taking part in it, both towering scholarly figures and institutions; he also thanked the forum's supporters and the researcher brothers who had laboured in preparing the papers to be presented at it.

Over three days the forum discusses several topics, among them the letter of guarantee and the ruling on charging a fee for it; the reconciliation of the public right in taxation with the protection of private right; insurance and its rulings; and likewise the ruling on opening an account with banks that deal in usurious gain (ribā).

options: newly arising questions with no direct precedent
flags.note: A نازلة is a case for which the school's books hold no direct precedent, requiring fresh derivation; the nawāzil literature is a major Maliki and specifically Mauritanian genre. Not in the project glossary and a strong candidate for addition — record 881 flags the same term.

flags.context: the first topic on the forum's agenda
options: the letter of guarantee and the ruling on charging a fee for it
the bank guarantee and the ruling on the commission taken on it
the surety undertaking and the ruling on a wage for it
flags.note: خطاب الضمان is the banking instrument, a bank guarantee or letter of guarantee; the dispute is over whether the issuing bank may charge for it, since ḍamān is a gratuitous contract in classical fiqh. 'Fee' and 'commission' are both used in the Islamic-finance literature; a single rendering should be fixed for the corpus because the muʿāmalāt material recurs.

translator_notes: A news report written by the site. The Sheikh's opening address is reported indirectly; nothing is presented as his direct words.
The contrast 'نصوص محصورة / نوازل غير محصورة' is a standard uṣūlī formulation and has been kept as an argument, not compressed into its conclusion (style guide section 1).

'البنوك الربوية' is rendered 'banks that deal in usurious gain (ribā)' rather than 'interest-based banks': the glossary warns that ribā is a wider category than interest. The forum's agenda item is a question, not a ruling.
The CMS timestamp is a bulk-upload date, not the date of composition.
